.`catalog is camelCase, ordered by name, slot-fit only, prices as decimal strings (AC-211)`()

.`list has the contract shape, system profiles first then own, tagged refs, whole-cent prices (AC-10)`()
.`the list never shows another Owner's profile (AC-222)`()
.`a system profile is read by key, an own profile by id (AC-10)`()
.`another Owner's profile, an unknown uuid and a malformed key all give identical 404 not-found (AC-222)`()
.`a draft without a source is empty and a draft from a system profile is its copy (AC-218 happy side)`()
.`a draft from another Owner's or an unknown or malformed profile is 404 not-found (AC-222)`()
